item.title: Facilitating a mediated agreement
item.description: Describe how a facilitator handles a disagreement, tests proposals and helps participants move toward an agreement. Distinguish fairness, tone and specific stages of a negotiation.

children.definition: Shared views, interests or goals that can support further agreement.
children.example: They found common ground in wanting the playground to remain open at weekends.
children.translation_uz: kelishuvga asos boʻladigan umumiy qarash yoki manfaatlar

children.definition: A private meeting during mediation in which the mediator speaks with one party without the other party present.
children.example: In a caucus, the tenant told the mediator which repair dates would actually work.
children.translation_ru: отдельная встреча медиатора с одной из сторон
children.translation_uz: mediatorning tomonlardan biri bilan alohida uchrashuvi

children.definition: A point in a discussion when progress stops because the parties cannot agree how to proceed.
children.example: The talks reached an impasse over who would have access to the shared entrance.

children.definition: Treating each side fairly without favoring any participant or outcome.
children.example: An impartial facilitator let each neighbor explain the problem before discussing possible changes.
children.translation_uz: xolis, hech bir tomonga yon bosmaydigan

children.definition: To reduce the intensity of a conflict or make a tense situation less likely to worsen.
children.example: The mediator paused the discussion to de-escalate the argument before asking either person to reply.

children.definition: A protective condition or measure that reduces the risk of harm or misuse.
children.example: The agreement included a safeguard requiring both groups to approve changes to the timetable.
children.translation_uz: zararning oldini olishga qaratilgan himoya chorasi

children.definition: A realistic agreement in which each side gives up something and can carry out the result.
children.example: Sharing the room on alternate evenings was a workable compromise for the two groups.
children.translation_uz: har ikki tomon amalga oshira oladigan murosa

children.definition: A basic rule agreed before an activity that tells participants how to take part.
children.example: The first ground rule allowed each resident to speak without interruption.
children.translation_uz: muhokama boshida kelishib olinadigan asosiy qoida

children.definition: To present an issue from a different angle so people can understand or discuss it differently.
children.example: The facilitator asked them to reframe the dispute as a question about access to the hallway.
children.translation_ru: рассматривать или формулировать вопрос под другим углом

children.definition: An honest intention to deal fairly and engage sincerely with the other side.
children.example: Both groups showed good faith by sharing their actual booking records.

children.definition: Intended to reduce disagreement and improve relations.
children.example: Her conciliatory opening acknowledged the other team’s concerns without accepting every demand.
children.translation_uz: kelishmovchilikni kamaytirish va munosabatni yaxshilashga qaratilgan

children.definition: Fair treatment in how a decision is made, including a meaningful chance to be heard.
children.example: The facilitator protected procedural fairness by giving each resident the same opportunity to answer the complaint.
children.translation_uz: qaror qabul qilish jarayonida adolatli muomala

children.definition: A suggested arrangement that does not require anyone to accept or follow it.
children.example: The facilitator circulated a nonbinding proposal so both groups could react before making any commitment.

children.definition: A complaint about something a person or group considers unfair.
children.example: The residents raised a grievance about how the booking rules had been applied.
children.translation_uz: adolatsiz deb hisoblangan holat yuzasidan shikoyat
